maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from diagnostic imaging scans and radiology reads for patients, not repair or servicing of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Outpatient imaging is paid mostly by commercial insurers plus Medicare; the website doesn't show government as the majority payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Building a partnership of physician-owned radiology practices and imaging centers across 13 states, growing through practice acquisitions and joint ventures.

mission_critical.reason: Outpatient imaging centers compete with hospitals and other providers; referrers and patients can switch fairly easily.

notes: Payer mix and switching costs for hospital joint-venture partners are judged from general knowledge, not the website.
